searchText: I *think* arbitrum was thinking on using something intermediate, using slightly more than the 31 bytes but not the optimal approach of using several chunks to use the partial extra bits. But <@165550481156866048> would definitely know better For reference, `math.log2(BLS_MODULUS)` is ~254.86 . That's ~31.86 bytes. The simplest solution would be to just encode 31 bytes of data into each field element, but that's only 97.3% efficiency. I believe Offchain Labs is currently looking at encoding 254 bits of data into each field element, which is 99.7% efficiency. You could theoretically encode even more data than that into each field element, but that complexity might not be worth the extra 0.3% of efficiency. hey <@412614104222531604> , just want to let you know that we are one merged PR away from being ready for devnet6 testing <#892088344438255616> is probably the more suitable channel for devnet 6 stuff. <@412614104222531604> I think I found an issue that will block geth from syncing the devnet. I try to fix it asap, but I can't guarantee to get it fixed by devnet launch geth won't have any validators to begin with, so no rush. Let me know when you have a potential fix, and I'll just update the geth images.
